body:
Live workaround (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-14 08:37Z), holding until w-ad6b8a3b9064 is fixed. Drive C: hit 0 bytes free at about 08:33Z on 2026-10-14 and killed a full gate (os error 112). Each fresh TermAl worktree builds its own 4-7 GB cargo target/ (debug plus tests), and nothing removes it after landing. 121 had accumulated under TermAl/.tmp. The coordinator freed 273 GB by deleting the target/ dirs of inactive worktrees (inside the repo, absolute-path checked, target/ only).
RULES until w-ad6b lands:
(1) Before granting a cold-compile focused run or a Merger gate in a FRESH root, check `(Get-PSDrive C).Free` and keep at least 50 GB free.
(2) After each landing, the Merger (or coordinator) deletes the landed carry root's target/ (its own worktree, absolute-path checked).
(3) Periodically delete the target/ of worktrees for completed or released items, never a worktree with an active claim or a running check.
(4) Engram removes finished worktrees at landing and keeps about 31 GB in its active ones.
